questions.q: Bill C-41, which changes the rules for medically assisted dying, faced its first big vote in the House. What happened?
questions.why: It passed and now goes to committee for detailed study.

questions.q: There were 3,839 reported lobbying meetings in September. Was October higher or lower?
questions.why: Much higher: 6,356, a 66% jump in the weeks before the budget.

questions.q: Tap these steps in the order a bill goes through them.
questions.why: First vote (second reading), committee study, Senate review, then Royal Assent makes it law.

questions.q: “Keeps the federal tax on fuel off until the end of January 2027.”
questions.why: C-38, the Canadian Fuel Affordability Act. The tax returns at half rate in February and in full in April 2027.

questions.q: Where did Prime Minister Carney meet China's President Xi Jinping this week?
questions.why: Shenzhen, at the APEC summit. It was the last stop of a four-country trip.
